name: control
note: Cards in the registry count most (it builds up there), cards in hand and the fortress STR race count less; one's own STR is kept dear (ownStr), taking down the other side's board counts extra (oppBoard), attackers that are ready count little: it builds up, answers their cards, trades, and goes at the user less. Measured on 98 matches each way against simple: registry 2.9 at the end of its turns (beatdown CPUs 2.3-2.8), attacks at cards 18% (13%), trades 0.5 a match (0.3), kills 0.9 (0.5).
